cards.title: Parenting is hard. Should we let AI do it for us?
cards.body: Tech companies offer eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts and 'optimized nap predictions' to help parents. The question is: who actually needs this?

cards.title: Should I try the '18 summers' parenting trend?
cards.body: Modern parenting trends often turn summer into a 'making memories' exercise rather than letting children have unstructured time. Long days with nothing to do is the whole point of summer.

cards.title: I forgot so much about having a second baby
cards.body: A parent reflects on the challenges of a second child, from food to teeth to poos. Their mum's help has stirred up memories of their own blissfully bored childhood.

cards.title: Your quiet child may be the most overwhelmed
cards.body: The child who screams gets everyone's attention, but the silent child may need just as much help. Adults often miss distress that looks like 'nothing'.

cards.title: 5 Reasons the Emotional Lives of Parents Matter
cards.body: Understanding your emotional life as a parent can deepen your connection with your children. Your feelings directly impact family dynamics and child development.
